C1307.title: Anqing Police Dismantle Cross-Border Pig-Butchering Scam Dens
C1307.summary: The Yixiu Branch of the Anqing Public Security Bureau simultaneously closed the net in Guangxi and Sichuan, dismantling two cross-border pig-butchering scam dens, arresting 11 suspects, and seizing over 20 computers, more than 50 mobile phones, and several bank cards and virtual wallets.
